node.title: RS common-root weighted basis charge
node.statement: For a post-strip RS selector with affine kernel rank a, let G be the global common-root set of the kernel slice and P_0 the roots persistent on the whole affine family. The RS gcd bound gives |G|<=k-a, while every root in G\P_0 can vanish at only one selected slope. A loopless refinement of the cogirth basis lemma gives a*b_e>=m_e*C(a+h-1,a-1), where m_e is the number of nonloop zeros. Combining the summed basis supply with the per-basis post-strip pencil cap yields the exact common-root inequality and its endpoint envelope. Exact XR arithmetic pays selector ranks 4,4,4,16,16,14, moving the first open prize ranks to 17,17,15.
